attributes.powers: For your combat check, discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill + 3d8, or 3d12 against a bane that has the Aquatic trait. After the encounter, each other character at your location is dealt 1 Fire damage, and you may examine the top 2 cards of your location deck.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 13 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
